name: app-chip
title: AppChip + ChipVariant enum + factory presets
completion_summary: Implemented AppChip with ChipVariant enum, 3 variants (filled/outlined/soft), 4 factory presets (presencePresent/presenceAbsent/memberRole/meetingStatus), avatar/onDeleted/onPressed support, press feedback via AnimatedOpacity at 0.85 opacity

public_api.constructor:
AppChip({
  required String label,
  Widget? avatar,
  VoidCallback? onDeleted,
  VoidCallback? onPressed,
  ChipVariant variant = ChipVariant.filled,
  Color? color,
})

conventions_reminder: All colors/spacings/radii/durations via tokens — no hardcoded values
Press feedback via opacity (0.8) with disableAnimations guard
Double quotes on all string literals
Top-of-file doc comment explaining purpose + state behavior
acceptance_criteria: Factory presets: presencePresent (success), presenceAbsent (error), memberRole (primary), meetingStatus (cta)
